corpus.note: Line numbers are valid only for this commit. Clone with --depth 1 and check out this sha before scoring. The source is NOT committed: it is third-party code, and the provenance rule keeps it out of the repository.
corpus.include_note: **/*.py INCLUDING the test suite. Source-only would be 2,452 (pytest) and 2,652 (pydantic) chunks, far short of the ~10,000 this corpus exists to provide. Including every readable suffix would reach 9,653 / 13,377 but ~25-30% of those chunks are RST and Markdown, which would make a corpus counted as Python mostly not Python. `**/*.py` with tests is both 100% Python and at the target scale, and it is what our own walker would really store from this repository.

fields.query: the question, as a developer would ask it
fields.file: the file holding the answer, spelled as Chunk.source spells it
fields.expects: line numbers in that file that answer it
fields.wording: named if it shares ordinary words with the answer, paraphrase if it deliberately avoids them

queries.query: how many tests are expected to be skipped in the provided example
what happens when a test fails because of a nested import problem
what happens if the matcher cannot handle the expression
how is a mock path object created for testing
how are files listed in a json file used to find tests
which python version is required for the same exception group handling
what is returned when the setup plan option is enabled
what is printed to the error stream when a system exit occurs
how can a single mark or a list of marks be applied to a specific parameter set
queries.anchor: A single mark or a list of marks to be applied to this parameter set.

queries.query: where is the number of garbage collection cycles stored
how many times should the setup and teardown messages be counted
what happens if the keys of the compared objects do not match
what warning is issued when the cache directory is not writable
to what extent can a single parameter set be hidden from the test name
queries.anchor: Can only be used at most 1 time, as

queries.query: how many characters are used to represent the result of a test run in the test terminal output
queries.anchor: one file name per line, single character describing result

queries.query: what does the executable script for the frozen version do
how do i get the folder where the test runner was started
what is the default scope for a fixture if none is provided
does a custom equality check that calls the parent class method result in two objects with different field values being equal
can i change the logging level for a specific logger instance
